words.def: the top part of the body, above the neck
words.ex: He turned his head to look at me.

words.def: the thin threads that grow on a person's head
the part of the body used for seeing
the part of the body used for hearing
words.ex: The music was so loud it hurt my ears.

words.def: the part of the face used for smelling and breathing
words.ex: The dog has a cold, wet nose.

words.def: the part of the face used for eating and speaking
words.ex: Don't talk with your mouth full.

words.def: one of the hard white parts in the mouth
words.ex: Brush your teeth twice a day.

words.def: the part of the body joining the head to the shoulders
words.ex: She wore a scarf around her neck.

words.def: the long part of the body from the shoulder to the hand
words.ex: He broke his arm playing football.

words.def: the part of the body at the end of the arm
one of the five long parts on the hand
words.ex: She pointed at the map with her finger.

words.def: one of the parts of the body used for walking
words.ex: My legs are tired after the long walk.

words.def: the part of the body at the end of the leg
the organ that pumps blood around the body
words.ex: Running is good for your heart.

words.def: the rear part of the body from neck to hips
words.ex: He hurt his back lifting the box.
